title: Young people across Europe stage coordinated ‘fight for our future’ protests
summary_full: Activists in more than 20 countries demonstrate over cost of living, learning conditions and rising military spendingStudents and young workers have taken to the streets in more than 20 European countries in coordinated protests over the surging cost of living and housing, deteriorating learning conditions and rising military spending.Activists from more than 50 groups in countries including Belgium, France, Germany, Greece, Italy, Portugal, Spain and the UK held rallies on Friday, lighting flares, burning cardboard models of tanks and waving placards, many reading “fight for our future”.
